name: Additional Product Information 3
definition: Additional information required for distribution in the UK market.

FinancialInstrumentTransactionCostsExAnt.name: Financial Instrument Transaction Costs Ex Ante UK
FinancialInstrumentTransactionCostsExAnt.definition: Cost associated with the transaction. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 09010 and this is a percentage of the NAV of the financial instrument expressed in annualised terms (rate of cost deduction to be applied).
